draftContext.markdown: Three PRs merged this interval: core #621 (FleetRunner 0.2.1), daily-logger #554 (LangGraph SQLite fixture + delivery plan), daily-logger #552 (blog 2026-11-17). Core #622 (DRAFT, lease handoff correction) opened at 05:49Z within this interval and is the immediate continuation of the wake-proof arc — likely the next operator review target in core. Daily-logger #555 (PostgreSQL checkpoint parity, DRAFT) and #556 (blinded comparison plan, DRAFT) also opened this interval and together sketch the two milestones between the landed SQLite fixture and production cutover; neither has test results or a merge event in this window. #555 is a dependency for #556. Daily-logger #548 (LocalHelp sweep registration, non-draft, opened 2026-11-16) has no merge event; owner decision on merge priority is needed — 30+ HelpDesk PRs have been invisible to the drafter since November 1st. Core #602 (stale-docs cleanup 2026-11-14, non-draft) has been open four days with no documented blocker; disposition needed. The five independent audit DRAFTs (#541, #545, #547, #551, #553) are record-keeping artifacts by design and are not blocking downstream work. The blinded comparison PR (#556) does not yet specify evaluation criteria or human-in-the-loop requirements for the third agent; that gap needs to be closed before the comparison phase is actionable. Core DRAFTs #619, #600, #598, #597, #596, #595 are parked planning and infrastructure work; merge-conflict status on long-lived DRAFTs is unknown from available evidence. BookcaseDiscovery #104 (stale-docs cleanup 2026-11-17) is open non-draft with no merge event.
